Figure 5: Spatial distortion in the key cache. Weakened retrieval of visual evidence leads to diffuse decoding attention.

Figure 8: Saliency-Driven Attention Redistribution. (1) Localization: low-entropy head aggregation locates global candidates. (2) Redistribution: per-head averaging weakens nonsemantic peaks and preserves semantic regions.

Figure 7: Pipeline of SDPR. SDPR performs coordinated interventions across the perception, memory, and prediction stages: (1) Perception: SDAR redistributes attention from non-semantic sink tokens toward salient visual features; (2) Memory: SDCA mitigates position-dependent distortion and re-anchors query-relevant visual features in the key cache; and (3) Prediction: PCD contrasts the original logits with a language-prior reference to suppress prior-dominated predictions.
